key_concepts: The respiratory system enables breathing and gas exchange
The nose, pharynx, larynx, trachea, bronchi, and lungs are respiratory organs
Alveoli are tiny air sacs where oxygen and carbon dioxide are exchanged
The diaphragm is a dome-shaped muscle that helps breathing
Cilia in the nasal cavity filter, warm, and moisten air
The circulatory system transports oxygen, nutrients, and hormones and removes wastes
Arteries carry blood away from the heart and veins carry blood toward the heart
The heart has upper chambers called atria and lower chambers called ventricles
Red blood cells deliver oxygen, white blood cells fight infection, and platelets help bloo
The nervous system controls and regulates body activities
The central nervous system includes the brain and spinal cord
The cerebrum controls thinking, the cerebellum controls balance, and the brainstem control
